source_conversation.content: I'm on Windows 11 and links keep opening in Edge when I click them. I want Chrome to be the one that opens links. How do I set that?

sections.text: On Windows 11: If you don't have Google Chrome on your computer yet, first download and install Chrome. Select Start. Select Settings, then Apps, then Default apps. Under 'Set defaults for applications,' in the search box, enter Chrome. Select Google Chrome. At the top, next to 'Make Google Chrome your default browser,' select Set default. To make sure the change is applied to the correct file types, review the list under 'Set default file types or link types.'

On Windows 10: If you don't have Google Chrome on your computer yet, first download and install Chrome. Select Start, and then select Settings. Open your default apps. Original version: select System, and then Default apps. Creators Update: select Apps, and then Default apps. At the bottom, under 'Web browser,' select your current browser. In the 'Choose an app' window, select Google Chrome.

source_conversation.content: I'm on my laptop in Chrome and one website keeps opening pop-up windows over everything. How do I stop that one site from doing it?

sections.text: On Chrome on a computer: Open Chrome and click More, then Settings. Click Privacy and security, then Site Settings, then Pop-ups and redirects. Under 'Allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects,' find the site. Click More next to the site, then Block. If the site isn't listed, click Add next to 'Not allowed to send pop-ups or use redirects,' enter the site's web address, and then click Add. To cover an entire domain, use the pattern [*.]example.com.
